//: Replaces the Apache .htaccess this project used before moving to Vercel. Vercel terminates TLS and serves HTTPS itself, so no HTTPS redirect rule is needed here.

redirects.//: Exactly one hostname must serve the site or Google splits ranking signals between duplicates. Apex is canonical, matching the <link rel=canonical> tags. www must also be added as a domain in the Vercel project or requests to it never reach this rule.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints everything under /assets, so those files are immutable and can be cached for a year.
Unhashed files in public/ change in place, so they need revalidation.
